description: This file defines API endpoints for managing orders in a food delivery platform using FastAPI and SQLAlchemy. It includes functionality for creating orders, retrieving current and past orders, updating order status with role-based access control, assigning couriers, and emitting tracking events.

methods.name: None _emit_tracking( session: AsyncSession, order_id: UUID, event_type: str, message: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Emits a tracking event by inserting into tracking_events table and publishing via websocket.

methods.name: OrderOut _get_order_with_items(session: AsyncSession, order_id: UUID)
methods.description: Retrieves an order along with its items and associated details, raises 404 if not found.

methods.name: OrderOut create_order( payload: CreateOrderRequest, user: AuthUser = Depends(require_roles("customer", "admin")), session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Creates a new order with items, calculates totals, and initializes order status to pending_payment.

methods.name: List[OrderOut] my_current_orders( user: AuthUser = Depends(require_roles("customer", "admin")), session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Retrieves all active (not completed) orders for the current customer.

methods.name: List[OrderOut] my_order_history( user: AuthUser = Depends(require_roles("customer", "admin")), session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Retrieves all completed or canceled orders for the current customer.

methods.name: OrderOut get_order( order_id: UUID, user: AuthUser = Depends(get_current_user), session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Retrieves an order by ID with access control: customer, owner, courier, or admin.

methods.name: OrderOut update_order_status( order_id: UUID, payload: UpdateOrderStatusRequest, user: AuthUser = Depends(get_current_user), session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Updates the status of an order with role-based permission enforcement and emits tracking events.

methods.name: dict assign_courier( order_id: UUID, courier_user_id: UUID, user: AuthUser = Depends(require_roles("admin")), session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Assigns a courier to an order; admin only, updates or creates delivery assignment.
